explanation: The apostle who writes the letter and describes his sufferings for the sake of Jesus.
People who pretend to be true servants but have an agenda other than God's will.
The evil power that can disguise itself as an angel of light to deceive people.
The work and sacrifices Paul carries out in faithfulness to Christ.
The physical and emotional pains the apostle has endured, including beatings and dangers.
The condition where human strength is lacking so that God's power can be most clearly revealed.
The political system that often persecuted Christians at the time the letter was written.
